question: How many new locally acquired dengue cases will the Week 42 FDOH arbovirus report (October 18–24, 2026) show for Florida?

calls.reasoning: Reference class: recent weekly FDOH local dengue counts during this 2026 outbreak (W34-W40: 32,38,41,~62,62,44,72), rising ~+8/week on a smoothed basis. Officials as of Oct 13-15 said there's no sign the epidemic curve is declining; heavy early-to-mid October rains and spread into Pinellas point to continued or higher counts 2 weeks out, given the incubation and reporting lag. Against that: the largest spraying campaign yet, seasonal cooling in late October, and noisy reporting. Median ~70, close to the latest week, with a right tail for continued growth (>120 at about 7%). No human market found on Polymarket or Manifold; Kalshi and bookmakers not checked directly.

- Searched but not found: the W41 count, an FDOH onset-date epi curve, and any prediction market (none on Polymarket/Manifold).
